snippet.title: Omega Pilot Evolution - Launch Trailer | PS5 & PS VR2 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10015764

Omega Pilot Evolution launches on PS5 and PS VR2, playable fully in VR or on a flat screen. Take on a global Career mode, racing asynchronously against the best times set by players worldwide. Jump into real-time multiplayer, battle it out in classic or combat races, or challenge AI opponents solo. Customize your ship and upgrade its performance, then compete cross-platform between VR and flat-screen pilots. Built by a small independent team pushing arcade-fast racing to its limits.

#ps5 #ps5games #psvr2 #psvr2games
